description.zh:
子组件ID列表，
传入则只返回这些组件的参数和参数模版
description.en: A list of subcomponent IDs. If you specify this parameter, the operation returns the parameters and parameter templates for only these components.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-application-parameters --application-id pa-00000000000000 --component-id-list pac-00000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
